ModMetaData.name: SimplyUI - UI Customization
ModMetaData.author: alt4s
ModMetaData.description: Adds lightweight UI theming: accent/background colors, individually toggleable per-element colors and textures (windows, tabs, buttons, gizmos, scrollbar, checkboxes, sliders, and more), custom fonts, custom cursors (including animated .ani), main menu background rotation, and custom UI sounds. Supports exporting themes as standalone, shareable mods.
